text_blocks.snippet: Antidepressants are medications used to treat depression, a serious medical illness that affects mood and overall mental health. They work by influencing neurotransmitters, chemicals in the brain that regulate mood and other functions. While it can take several weeks for antidepressants to become fully effective, they can significantly improve symptoms of depression and help individuals regain a sense of well-being.
